Name: Rose's Large Cheese and Mayonnaise
Author: Roseloves109
Description:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/3BZwynT/Add-a-heading.png[/img]
[size=3][i]This mod adds Large Goat Cheese, Large Normal Cheese, and Large Mayo. These Goods are worth double the normal value. These is Designed to be used my mod "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28023]Cruelty Free Meat Mod[/url]". Since My mod Allows Players to Grow animal products, this mod is design to increase profit. It can be used by Itself too.

[/i][/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28864/][img]https://i.ibb.co/tKg59kg/2.png[/img]

[/url][b]Prices of Large Goods. [/b]
[list=1]
[*][i]Large Mayo is Worth 400g[/i][/*]
[*][i]Large Normal Cheese is Worth 500g[/i][/*]
[*][i]Large Goat Cheese is Worth 1000g[/i][/*]
[/list][i]
[b]More Information[/b][/i]
[list]
[*][i][i]You can "crafted" large products into 2 normal products. You can get Cooking Recipes at[b] farming level 1.[/b][/i][/i][/*]
[*][i][i]Products keep Quality of input item.[/i][/i][/*]
[*][i][i]You can age the Large Cheeses in Casks[/i][/i][/*]
[/list]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28023/][img]https://i.ibb.co/k64q9BH/Add-a-heading-1.png[/img][/url]
